nodes.label: Neural Operators Framework
nodes.author: Anima Anandkumar
nodes.rationale: Universal framework for learning mappings between function spaces. Discretization-invariant, works at any resolution. Combines data-driven learning with physics constraints (PDEs, symmetries, conservation laws).

nodes.label: FourCastNet: AI Weather Model
nodes.author: Anima Anandkumar (lead)
nodes.rationale: First high-resolution fully AI-based weather model using Spherical Fourier Neural Operators. 10,000–100,000× faster than traditional models. Trained on ~50k samples (ERA5 reanalysis). Predicts extreme weather (hurricanes) days ahead.

nodes.label: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs)
nodes.rationale: Solve PDEs by imposing PDE residual as loss function (test-time optimization). Slower than numerical solvers for many problems; optimization landscape often intractable. Contrasts with data-driven Neural Operators.

nodes.label: Closure Modeling vs. End-to-End Neural Operators
nodes.rationale: Closure models augment numerical solvers with learned corrections (additive, coarse-grid only). Neural Operators replace solvers end-to-end (4–6 orders magnitude faster, differentiable, nonlinear multiscale mixing). Operators achieve better data efficiency and stability.
